question: For email lists with names starting with e (case insensitive), containing 10 to 20 members inclusive, and where over 75% are computer science students, provide the list name, owner, and member count.

SELECT
    l.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
    o.OWNER AS owner,
    COUNT(*) AS member_count
FROM MOIRA_LIST l
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL d ON l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER o ON d.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = o.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s ON d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER = s.EMAIL_ADDRESS
WHERE LOWER(l.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE 'e%'
GROUP BY l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, l.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, o.OWNER
HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 10 AND 20
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 4 > COUNT(*) * 3

t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME), dept_variability AS (WITH inner_cte AS (WITH most_recent_year AS (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED`), dept_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccs JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND NOT ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.coefficient_of_variation, i.avg_total_units, avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation AS benchmark_coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation > variability_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats) SELECT s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.STUDENT_YEAR, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.window_column, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, d.coefficient_of_variation, d.avg_total_units, d.benchmark_coefficient_of_variation, d.variability_category FROM student_info AS s JOIN dept_variability AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME

OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.FIRST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t0 JOIN t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME), dept_variability AS (WITH inner_cte AS (WITH most_recent_year AS (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED`), dept_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccs JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND NOT ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.coefficient_of_variation, i.avg_total_units, avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation AS benchmark_coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation > avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation < avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variability_category, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME) WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t0.TERM_END_DATE, MIN(t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND t1.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.window_column, t1.IS_CURRENT_TERM, t2.IS_REGULAR_TERM FROM inner_cte JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t1 ON inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION = t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE     l.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
    o.OWNER AS owner,
    COUNT(*) AS member_count
FROM MOIRA_LIST l
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL d ON l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER o ON d.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = o.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s ON d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER = s.EMAIL_ADDRESS
WHERE LOWER(l.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE 'e%'
GROUP BY l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, l.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, o.OWNER
HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 10 AND 20
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 4 > COUNT(*) * 3

FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL d
JOIN MOIRA_LIST l ON l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER o ON o.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = d.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s ON s.EMAIL_ADDRESS = d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
LEFT JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT dep ON dep.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WHERE LOWER(l.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE 'e%'
GROUP BY l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, l.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, o.OWNER
HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 10 AND 20
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN dep.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 4 > COUNT(*) * 3
